couldntOpenReaper: Couldn't open REAPER. Launch it manually.
nameFirst: Enter your name first, so the others know who you are.
vpnHint: A VPN is on, which can hide sessions on this network. An invite code still works.
checkNoAnswer: No answer from the host. Try again.
logUnsafeMediaPath: Ignored an incoming item that points to a file outside the project.
sessionContested: Two devices claim to be the host
trustBody: Plugins in the project can run code.
invalidTicket: This doesn't look like a ReaMesh invite code.
ticketJoinHint: Outside this network, an invite code needs a shared VPN such as Tailscale, or a relay set up by the host.
joinNoFxHint: View-only copy, all effect chains removed. No third-party code runs.
hostCloudWarning: The project is in a cloud folder. Pause syncing while you host.
verifyBodyListed: These plugins weren't on the host's list:
verifyBodyNoList: The host sent no plugin list. The project loads these plugins:
inviteTicketHint: Send this code to anyone you want to invite. They can paste it in their lobby to join. Outside your network that takes a shared VPN such as Tailscale, or a relay. The code works while you host this session.
banBody: {name} will be removed and can't rejoin for 30 minutes.
peerKickedUnnamed: You removed a guest from the session.
peerBannedUnnamed: You blocked a guest for 30 minutes.
kickedByHost: The host removed you from the session. You can rejoin.
bannedByHost: The host blocked you from this session for {minutes} minutes.
bannedFromSession: The host has blocked you from this session.
reaperBusyHint: A dialog is probably open there.
notReaperDirWarning: This folder has no reaper.ini. Is it REAPER's data folder?
firewallBody: On first start, Windows asks for network access. Choose “Private networks” and “Allow access”.
firewallNamesReaper: The prompt says REAPER because ReaMesh runs inside it.
firewallRecover: Open Windows Security, then go to Firewall & network protection → Allow an app through firewall. Enable Private for REAPER.
extInstalledToast: Extension installed. Restart REAPER to load it.
extUpdatedRestart: Extension updated. Restart REAPER to load it.
extUpdatedRestartSession: ReaMesh was updated. Restart REAPER after this session.
extRemovedToast: Extension removed. Restart REAPER to unload it.
hostLost: Lost the connection to the host.
logBrowsing: Searching for sessions on the network
logJoinUnavailable: Couldn’t join “{name}”. The session may have just ended. Try again.
logManifestTimeout: The host never sent the project file list. Try joining again.
logDownloadStalled: The download stopped partway through. Try joining again.
logDiskSpace: Not enough free disk space to download this project.
logProjectTooLarge: This project is too large to download.
logHostUnreachable: Couldn't reach the host. They may have stopped hosting.
logProjectChanged: You switched projects, so the session ended.
logTintsHealed: {count} items saved in grey got their color back.
logTintsHealedOne: 1 item saved in grey got its color back.
logMediaCopied: Copied {file} into the project folder so everyone gets it.
logMediaCopyFailed: Couldn’t copy into the project folder: {file}
logCopyNotSaved: Couldn’t update your copy of the project: the file is read-only or in use.
logCopyOpened: REAPER now has your saved copy open.
logCopyNotOpened: REAPER stays on the temporary copy: it may hold changes your saved copy doesn’t have. Save it as a copy again to keep them.
logCopyNotOpenedPlaying: REAPER stays on the temporary copy because playback or recording is under way. Your saved copy is ready to open.
logLocalCopyChanged: Your copy changed since the last session.
logLinkedCopyMissing: Couldn’t find the folder of your copy.
logLinkedCopyForeign: The folder of your copy holds a different project.
logLinkedCopyBusy: {file} is still open. Close the project in REAPER and join again.
logLinkedCopyUnsaved: Your copy has unsaved changes. Save them in REAPER first.
logLinkedCopyOpen: With undo turned off REAPER can’t tell whether your copy has unsaved changes. Save it and close its tab first.
logReconnecting: Connection to the host lost. Reconnecting to “{name}”…
logBadTicket: That invite code doesn’t look valid. Copy it again from the host.
ticketUnreachable: Couldn’t reach that host. Make sure they're still hosting and you're on the same network or VPN.
editLocked: That edit was undone because someone else is editing the same thing.
editLockedTrack: Your edit to “{track}” was undone because someone else is editing that track.
pluginNotInstalledHere: Not installed here, so it shows offline.
followEnded: Follow mode ended because they left the session.
nofxOpen: Opening a view-only copy without effects.
verifyHold: The downloaded project loads plugins the host didn't list.
reaperOutdatedBody: ReaMesh needs REAPER {min} or newer. You have {version}.
reaperMismatchHostNewer: The host runs REAPER {host}, you run {local}. Parts of the project may not load correctly here. Updating REAPER is recommended.
reaperMismatchHostOlder: The host runs REAPER {host}, you run {local}. Some of your edits may not arrive cleanly on their side.
logReaperMismatch: The host runs REAPER {host}, you run {local}. Some edits may not sync cleanly.
logProgressiveOpen: Project opened. Items waiting for their media: {count}
logLoadingReadonly: The project is still loading. Editing unlocks once everything is here.
logMediaReady: Everything is here. You can edit now.
logPlaceholdersUnresolved: {count} items never got their media and stay empty here.
logPlaceholdersUnresolvedOne: 1 item never got its media and stays empty here.
logPlaceholderBlocked: An item still waiting for its media wasn't synced.
logBadField: Ignored {count} incoming changes that weren't in the expected format.
logBadFieldOne: Ignored 1 incoming change that wasn't in the expected format.
logNofxSkipped: Skipped {count} incoming changes that would load effects or other code.
logNofxSkippedOne: Skipped 1 incoming change that would load effects or other code.
logTickError: Something went wrong while syncing. ReaMesh recovered and keeps going.
downloadStalled: The download isn't moving. The host may be offline.
reaperClosedSession: The session ended when REAPER closed.
portTrouble: Every ReaMesh port is taken. Close another REAPER instance and ReaMesh connects on its own.
fwBlocked: A firewall rule blocks REAPER. Others on your network can't reach you.
fwFixCopied: Copied. Paste it into PowerShell running as administrator.
resetIdentityHint: This installation has a stable, anonymous peer ID so others can recognize you across sessions. If you reset it, ReaMesh creates a new ID the next time you join or host.
resetIdentityBody: Others will no longer recognize you from earlier sessions. ReaMesh creates a new ID the next time you join or host.
identityWasReset: Identity reset. ReaMesh will create a new one for your next session.
inviteWaitsInLobby: Invite code received. It will be waiting in the lobby once you leave this session.
crashBody: The window couldn't finish loading, but your REAPER session is still running. Reload the app to continue.
hostOtherVersion: This host runs a different ReaMesh version.
hostUnverified: This host couldn’t confirm the password, so it isn’t the session you’re looking for.
nearbyBlocked: Bluetooth isn’t allowed for ReaMesh in System Settings.
nearbyHostHint: For guests whose network blocks the usual search, such as guest Wi-Fi. Only your network address is sent.
nearbySettingsLabel: Find and share sessions over Bluetooth
nearbySettingsSub: For networks that block the usual search, such as guest Wi-Fi.
relayNextHost: Applies the next time you host.
relayPaused: Relay is pausing, reconnects by itself
relayOutdated: Relay is outdated. Its operator can update it.
relayBudgetUsedUp: Its monthly budget is used up: only direct connections until {date}.
relayKeyBudgetUsedUp: Your share of it is used up: only direct connections until {date}.
relayBudgetNearly: {percent} % of its monthly budget is used.
relayKeyBudgetNearly: {percent} % of your share of it is used.
relayCoordination: Only helps connections go direct, carries no traffic.
relayOnlyLinkHint: A router doesn’t let a direct connection through, so everything runs over the relay and counts towards its monthly budget.
relayListRetry: The app keeps trying in the background.
relayListAskOperator: Ask the operator for a new code.
relayListNoBudget: {name} stopped relaying for this month. Joining only works if a direct connection can be made.
hostVisibleNone: Only visible on your local network
hostListOpen: Anyone with a code there sees the session and can join.
hostListProtected: Anyone with a code there sees the session. Joining takes the password.
hostListOff: The session stays off the lists. You can still invite with a code.
relayLinkList: Sessions others host here will show up in your lobby. Yours show up there too unless you turn that off.
relayListFull: You already have {max} relays. Remove one in Settings first.
relayLinkSub: Sessions you host can then be reached through it over the internet.
logVersionMismatch: The host runs a different ReaMesh version.
extOldBody: ReaMesh was updated. Restart REAPER so it loads the matching extension.
extOldInstallBody: REAPER runs an older ReaMesh extension. Install the matching one, then restart REAPER.
extBundledOldBody: This copy of ReaMesh carries an older REAPER extension, so restarting REAPER won't help. Reinstall ReaMesh.
extBundledOldDevBody: This development build bundles an older REAPER extension. Restart tauri dev to rebuild it, then restart REAPER.
appOldBody: REAPER runs a newer ReaMesh extension than this app.
updateReadyAfterSession: {version} is ready. You can restart after the session.
updateAfterSession: You can restart after the session.
joinedAutoClean: Copies you don’t keep are removed after 7 days without use.
trashBody: Frees {size} once the Trash is emptied.
trashBodyWin: Frees {size} once the Recycle Bin is emptied.
copyNoSpace: There isn’t enough room for this copy there.
copyInsideStaging: Copies in ReaMesh’s own storage get removed. Pick a folder outside it.
copyPartialTrashed: The incomplete copy is in the Trash.
copyPartialTrashedWin: The incomplete copy is in the Recycle Bin.
copyPartialKept: The incomplete copy is still there, marked as incomplete.
linkChoiceLabel: What to do with your copy
trashKeptNote: You marked this copy to keep.
cockosNotice: REAPER is a trademark of Cockos Incorporated. ReaMesh is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cockos.
nativeQuitHostingBody: If you quit, the session ends and everyone connected to you is disconnected.
nativeQuitClientBody: If you quit, you leave the session. The project stays open in REAPER, but changes will no longer sync.
